description: `__next__` returns the next item or raises `StopIteration`, and `__iter__` returns the iterator itself.
An object whose `__iter__` returns an iterator; a container returns a new one on every call.
The signal for "no more items"; once raised, an iterator must raise it on every later call.
Returns the next item, or `default` instead of raising when the iterator is exhausted.
An object for which `iter(obj) is obj`: files, generators, `map` and `zip` objects. It supports a single pass.
